item.title: Halide diffusion in mixed-halide perovskites and heterojunctions
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Viren Tyagi, Mike Pols, Geert Brocks, Shuxia Tao
arXiv:2601.11503v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Migration of halide defects guides ion transport in metal halide perovskites and controls the kinetics of halide mixing and phase separation. We study the diffusion of halide vacancies and interstitials in ȩCsPb(IₓBr₁₋ₓ)₃ and ȩCsPbI₃/ȩCsPbBr₃ heterojunctions by molecular dynamics simulations using neural network potentials trained on density functional theory calculations. We observe enhanced diffusion of both vacancies and interstitials in the mixed halide compounds compared to the single halide ones, as well as a difference in mobility between Br and I ions in the mixed compound. Diffusion across heterojunctions is governed by the interface structure, where a Br-rich interface blocks migration of vacancies in particular, but an I-rich…

item.title: DeepHartree：用于一次性密度泛函理论的泊松耦合神经场
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jiankun Wu, Jinming Fan, Chao Qian, Shaodong Zhou
线性组合原子轨道（LCAO）密度泛函理论在构造库仑项和自洽场迭代时计算开销很大。本文提出DeepHartree，一种将连续实空间预测与LCAO电子结构连接起来的泊松耦合神经场方法：利用E(3)等变网络预测Hartree势，再通过泊松方程得到电子密度，并结合原子中心高斯场与分子级校正保证电子数守恒。一次对角化即可恢复能量分量、前线能级和占据子空间，并为自洽场提供初始化，在基准数据集上表现出较低误差。

For minimal interorbital t-J or t-V on-site interactions, a random phase approximation uncovers regimes of instability towards incommensurate dₓy pair density wave (d-PDW) superconductivity with driven by interband pairing. arXiv:2503.19761v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We numerically investigate the telltale signs of pair-density-wave order (PDW) in the Kondo-Heisenberg chain by focusing on the momentum resolved spectrum in different parameter regimes. Density matrix renormalization group calculations reveal that this phase is characterized by a dispersion with two minima and four Fermi points, indicating the emergence of an effective next-nearest-neighbor hopping that arises as a second-order effect to avoid magnetic frustration. The pairs appear in the spectrum as in-gap bound states with weight concentrated in the hole pockets. item.title: 极强关联电子的泛函重整化群研究
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jonas Arnold, Peter Kopietz, Andreas Rückriegel
该研究针对强在位排斥 Hubbard 模型中的极强关联电子体系，使用强耦合泛函重整化群方法分析严格 U=∞ 极限下的低能物理。由于双占据被投影排除，体系中仅保留由 Hilbert 空间投影产生的运动学相互作用。对于平方晶格最近邻跃迁，结果显示电子谱显著重整化，带宽和准粒子权重随电子密度增加而强烈降低，同时阻尼和粒子-空穴不对称增强，并在空穴扇区形成极化子连续谱。低密度下体系近似符合费米液体图像，而高密度下表现为具有强磁关联的坏金属，暗示可能出现 Nagaoka 铁磁和条纹反铁磁等基态趋势。

item.title: Prevalent Mpc-scale lobes around quasars at cosmic noon revealed by Faraday rotation measures
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Renyue Cen, Gang Li, Russell Taylor, Dongzi Li
Giant radio lobes spanning tens of kiloparsecs to several megaparsecs are observed around quasars and are classified as FRI and FRII radio galaxies locally. In this work, we investigate, for the first time, the environments of high-redshift quasars during the cosmic noon using Faraday rotation measures. Through a statistical cross-correlation between foreground quasars and background rotation measure sources, we detect a significant rotation measure excess within about 1.5 megaparsecs of quasar positions. The excess amounts to 3.42±0.63 radians per square meter, with a local statistical significance of 3.38σ, indicating the presence of substantial magnetic fields. item.title: Magnetoelastic Waves in Ferromagnetic Thin Films Mediated by Dipolar Interactions
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Hiroki Yoshida, Ryohei Kono, Manato Fujimoto, Motoki Asano, Daiki Hatanaka, Kei Yamamoto, Shuichi Murakami
arXiv:2604.22523v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetoelastic coupling mediated by magnetic dipolar interactions is theoretically investigated in ferromagnetic thin films under an in-plane magnetic field. We develop a theoretical description that incorporates dipolar fields derived from Maxwell's equations in the presence of elastic deformations. The resulting coupled equations of motion predict hybridization between magnetostatic and Lamb waves. Numerical calculations for a yttrium iron garnet (YIG) film reveal anti-crossings in the dispersion relations, with hybridization gaps ranging from 0.1 to several MHz.
